QuestInfo.name: A Headache for Treasure Hunters
QuestInfo.0: Lara has a new source of trouble recently. Let's visit her and find out what's troubling her.
QuestInfo.1:
Now I need to take some action. Let's show them who's boss!  For Lara!

QuestInfo.2: I've done a perfect job with what Lara asked, she is now happy again!

0.0: Hello there, I have a severe headache these days and you know what's troubling me? The guard dogs of the treasure dungeon! Huskies and Brown Puppies might be a Mapler's best friend, but the guard dogs down there are everyone's enemy! So, are you going to help me? Please?

yes.0: Alright, soon you will understand why I'm making such a fuss about those fleabags. I still have the bitemarks on my butt! It hurts! Nothing like kneeling down to pick up a nice shiny object and catch a pair for fangs for your trouble! Now I've had enough! I've used all kinds of bait--meat, fish, and even doggie treats but none of them worked! This is a job for someone strong...you!
yes.1: Heh, I'd heal faster if you defeat #r50#b Skel Guard Dogs#k, #r30#b Mummy Guard Dogs#k, and #r10 #bAngry Guard Dogs#k. They are guarding MV's treasure in the Treasure Dungeon. Get yourself prepared and jump into the portal above. Good luck!

no.0: You will be sorry if you hear the reason why I'm only standing here. Talk to me again if you want to help!

1.0: You've done a great job for me! Thank you! Thank you! Don't be shy, take your rewards. You've earned them!

yes.0: Many treasure hunters shall be thankful to you, but come back soon, you never know when the monsters will return.

mob.0: Not enough, I want you defeat more monsters! I hope you understood me correctly this time.
